unavailable_fields.per_collective_wire_time_ms: No available collector separates NCCL wire transfer from in-kernel device waiting; the source metric sums kernel durations that include waiting (parent trace: rank 0 allreduce seq 22 starts ~10.2 ms before rank 1's identical-payload kernel and lasts 13.7 ms vs 3.6 ms). collective_calibration is a separate warmed reference experiment, not a decomposition of the candidate step.
unavailable_fields.per_bucket_link_bytes: device_telemetry NVLink/PCIe rates are device-wide NVML samples with native windows and cannot be attributed per bucket or per collective; converting logical payload sizes (28351488/157541376 bytes) into link traffic would invent measurements.
unavailable_fields.candidate_run_bucket_kernel_attribution: Exact bucket links require native correlation plus observed gradient-storage membership; only the parent discovery pass (observations.json) carries that instrumentation. The selected collectors run in separate warmed workers without bucket joins, so candidate bucket identity stays inherited from the parent and remains ambiguous if sizes coincide.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion_bo: execution_timeline reports clock-alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown.

plan.rationale: All three forced NCCL parameter candidates regressed both constraints (step_ms 253.9/295.5/289.4 vs limit 144.8; max-rank comm kernel sum 89.1/128.4/110.2 ms vs baseline 63.7 ms), so the least-regressed candidate 02ed8cf7 (nchannels=4, proto=Simple) is selected for diagnosis. The parent trace shows per-bucket kernel durations are wait-dominated (rank 0 ~13.5 ms vs rank 1 ~3.6 ms per identical 27 MB bucket; the metric is not wire time), so the comm-sum and step regressions must not be read as algorithm cost. nccl_tuning captures the actual algorithm/protocol/channel decisions in a separate warmed worker (kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol) to establish what the forced env really produced and what the default tuner selects at the observed sizes; collective_calibration measures a clean warmed full-world SUM f32 allreduce at the observed 28351488- and 157541376-byte sizes with correctness checks to separate transfer cost from arrival skew; execution_timeline attributes the ~90 ms of step-time regression not accounted for by NCCL kernels (step +116 ms vs comm +26 ms max-rank) via CPU submit association, synchronization events and per-device intervals. Nsys omitted: timelines alone cannot separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer or prove bucket identity, and execution_timeline already covers submit association. torch already ran; python_runtime and binding_cost target host dispatch and binding overhead, which cannot explain a 2x step regression with framework_fallbacks=0 and identical legacy binding; device_telemetry is device-wide and not attributable per collective; candidate_diagnostics has no described capability matching these questions. No failure-category policy or optimization action is presumed; the reference invocations in coverage are not treated as fallback.

unavailable_fields.nccl_wire_time_ms: NCCL kernel durations include device waiting, not wire time (source metric caveat; parent discovery shows the first 28351488 B bucket kernel at 156.29 ms on rank 0 vs 3.63 ms on rank 1), and nsys timelines cannot separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer, so wire time stays unknown.
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 (not_supported) on both GPU-4bead555 and GPU-69c59246; per-link counters are unavailable and must not be derived from logical payload (497759232 B logical per rank per step).
unavailable_fields.per_collective_pcie_bytes: device_telemetry reports device-wide NVML rates with native ~20 ms driver sampling windows not aligned to operator ranges, and its probe rates are not workload traffic; it cannot attribute PCIe bytes to the 13 collectives, so it was not selected.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matched CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown.
unavailable_fields.allreduce_performance_lower_bound_ms: collective_calibration is a synthetic full-world reference experiment with correctness checks, not a performance lower bound or critical-path estimate; not selected for this attribution question.
unavailable_fields.critical_path_speedup_ms: interval overlap in traces is local to one clock and uncovered communication is not a measured critical path or causal speedup (observations.json interpretation), so no critical-path claim is requested.

plan.rationale: All three parameter candidates failed the step_ms constraint (253.86/295.48/289.42 ms vs limit 144.80, reference 137.91) and none was accepted, but the regression is not attributable to NCCL kernel time: revision 02ed8cf7 (nchannels=4, proto=Simple) reaches rank-0 communication_kernel_sum_ms 60.119 ms, below the original reference 63.316/63.672 ms, while its step grows ~116 ms, and its rank asymmetry (60.119 vs 89.083 ms) mirrors the parent discovery trace where the first 28351488 B bucket kernel lasted 156.29 ms on rank 0 vs 3.63 ms on rank 1 - the summed metric is dominated by device waiting/skew, not transfer. Revision 02ed8cf7 is selected as the most discriminative candidate: closest to the constraint, the only one with a sub-reference rank, and the strongest skew signal. nccl_tuning: kernel entry names (ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL) do not identify the effective protocol, so capture actual warmed algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed sizes (12x 28351488 B + 1x 157541376 B f32 SUM allreduce, world 2, SHM/direct transport, default 2 channels) and verify whether nchannels=4/proto=Simple actually applied or fell back. execution_timeline: attribute the step-time growth to host submit gaps, synchronization, or device intervals via CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, sync events, per-device intervals and passive post-accumulate callbacks; clock alignment bounds exist for CPU submissions only and it never replaces a comm hook. nsys (status available in both ranks' capability records, useful for this overlap/attribution question): device timeline to test whether NCCL kernels still overlap backward compute (parent rank 1 had only 7.949 ms overlap of 63.633 ms) or serialize under the forced tuning; it will not be read as wire time or bucket-identity proof. binding_cost: the candidate is additive over parent fc9ec3b1 (legacy binding, 2 functional sites, framework_fallbacks 0, 13 candidate + 13 reference invocations), so clean AB/BA parent-vs-binding-only passthrough whole-invocation cost tests whether the +116 ms is binding overhead rather than algorithm cost; it omits candidate build/computation and reports whole-invocation cost. Excluded: torch (already ran); device_telemetry, collective_calibration and python_runtime as recorded in unavailable_fields or redundant (python_runtime perturbs execution and its host dispatch/binding question is covered cleanly by binding_cost plus execution_timeline). No failure-category policy or optimization action is presumed; unknowns are retained as unknown.
